about: CANDIDATE model names for tempo-launch setup. Sizes and licences are NEVER taken from this file: setup checks each name live against the official Ollama registry (registry.ollama.ai) on the user's computer and uses the registry's real size and licence. A name that does not verify is skipped, so a wrong or missing tag is safe. roles: fast, heavy, code, vision, embed. params_b comes from the tag name. The list is in order of preference: when two models are equally big, the earlier one wins. active_params_b is the published active parameter count of a mixture-of-experts model (dense models: same as params_b); on a computer without a GPU it decides speed.
